services.name: Public Karting
services.desc: Give karting a try at the Briggs & Stratton Motorplex at Road America! Experience the thrills of this one-of-a-kind facility that offers many challenging twists and turns all while reaching speeds of up to 40mph on one of the provided karts! services.desc: In conjunction with 4 Miles of Fitness, Road America’s 18-hole disc golf course will be open Mondays and Wednesdays from 6-8 p.m., May through September. During 4 Miles of Fitness nights, the cost is $5 at the gate per person (cash only). An 8-visit punch pass is available for $25 or a disc golf season membership is available for $60. Road America’s disc golf course is open and available to any ticket purchaser during public events for no additional charge.
